# Level catalog reference

<!-- Generated by `player --level-schema docs/LevelSchema.md`; don't edit by hand. -->

The level catalog lists a game's levels. The project's `levels` key names it, by convention
`Config/Levels.swlevels`. See docs/Levels.md for how it's used. A project without one has a
single implicit level, `startup`: its startup scene.

## Format

The first line is `shockwave_levels 1`. `#` starts a comment. Values are quoted, except `kind`.

| Key | Where | Values | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `entry` | top, once | level id | the level the game starts in |
| `level` | top, repeats | level id | starts a level block, closed by `end` |
| `scene` | level, required | project-relative `.swscene` | the level's scene |
| `kind` | level, required | `menu`, `gameplay`, `ending` | what the level is for |
| `default_spawn` | level, optional | spawn id | the LevelSpawn players arrive at |
| `next` | level, optional | level id | the default destination; never automatic |
| `preload` | level, repeats | project-relative file | loaded before the level starts |

Level and spawn ids are 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, `-` and `_`, starting with a letter.
Paths stay inside the project. Cycles through `next` are allowed (replays, rotations).

## Components

| Component | Fields | Rules |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `LevelSpawn` | `id` ("start"), `team` (-1: any) | id unique in the scene |
| `LevelExit` | `destination`, `spawn`, `enabled` (true), `one_shot` (true) | destination is a catalog level; spawn, if given, is a LevelSpawn there |
| `Checkpoint` | `id`, `spawn`, `enabled` (true) | id unique in the scene; spawn is a LevelSpawn in it |
| `PersistentIdentity` | `id` | lowercase UUID, unique in the level; inside a prefab copy it combines with the copy's own |

## Diagnostic codes

Codes are stable; tools can match them. Messages may change.

| Code | Severity | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `LevelHeader` | error | the first line isn't `shockwave_levels 1` |
| `LevelUnsupportedVersion` | error | a catalog version this build can't read |
| `LevelUnreadable` | error | the file can't be opened or read |
| `LevelUnknownKey` | error | a key this version doesn't have |
| `LevelDuplicateKey` | error | a key given twice (other than `preload`) |
| `LevelStructure` | error | a level key outside a block, an `end` without a `level`, or an unclosed block |
| `LevelMissingKey` | error | a level without `scene` or `kind`, or a catalog without levels |
| `LevelInvalidValue` | error | a malformed id, kind, value or repeated preload |
| `LevelDuplicateId` | error | two levels with one id |
| `LevelNoEntry` | error | no `entry` |
| `LevelUnknownEntry` | error | `entry` names no level |
| `LevelUnknownNext` | error | `next` names no level |
| `LevelPathOutside` | error | a path that's absolute or leaves the project, by `..` or a link |
| `LevelPathCase` | error | a path spelt differently from the disk, or two scenes differing only by case |
| `LevelSceneMissing` | error | a scene that doesn't exist |
| `LevelPreloadMissing` | error | a preload that doesn't exist |
| `LevelSceneBroken` | error | a level's scene, or a prefab in it, doesn't load |
| `LevelSpawnMissing` | error | `default_spawn` isn't a LevelSpawn in the scene |
| `LevelDuplicateSpawn` | error | two LevelSpawns with one id in a scene |
| `LevelExitDestination` | error | a LevelExit whose destination isn't a level |
| `LevelExitSpawn` | error | a LevelExit spawn that isn't a LevelSpawn in the destination |
| `LevelCheckpoint` | error | a Checkpoint id that's malformed or used twice |
| `LevelCheckpointSpawn` | error | a Checkpoint whose spawn isn't a LevelSpawn in its scene |
| `LevelPersistentId` | error | a PersistentIdentity that isn't a valid UUID, or a prefab copy without one |
| `LevelDuplicatePersistentId` | error | two entities with one persistent identity in a level |
| `LevelNoCamera` | error | a gameplay level with no primary Camera, or a menu/ending with neither a Camera nor a UIDocument |
| `LevelUnreachable` | warning | nothing leads to the level from the entry |
| `LevelOptionConflict` | error | `--level` combined with `--scene`, `--load` or an online option |
